subject: Private VPC/on-prem architecture review - scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC/on-prem architecture review - next steps
Attachments: fintechcorp-precall-notes.pdf, redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about FintechCorp's latency requirements and data isolation needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap:
  - Primary use case: customer support assistant + internal analytics with sensitive PII stored in your environment.
  - Desire: Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.
  - Targets: sub-300ms 95th percentile for short-form prompts, predictable throughput during EOD spikes.

- Risks / open questions we flagged:
  - Network egress / IP allowlist requirements
  - Key management preferences (KMS vs HSM)
  - Data residency and retention policies for logs/cache

- Proposed next step: Technical deep-dive / architecture review (VPC/on-prem) with our Solutions Architect (Vivek) to walk through deployment options, network topology, and pre-req checklist.

Proposed slots (all PT):
  - Thu Aug 6, 10:00–11:00
  - Thu Aug 6, 14:00–15:00
  - Mon Aug 9, 11:00–12:00

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (e.g., infra, security, procurement)? I attached a short pre-read and our VPC checklist so Vivek can tailor the session.

If none of the times work, send 2–3 times that do and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attendees from FintechCorp: myself (Product), Sarah Jenkins (Security/compliance), and I expect to add Michael Ortiz (Infra lead) — I'll confirm Michael after checking his calendar.

Two quick asks ahead of the call if possible:
1) Can you share any example network diagrams or typical VPC peering/topology you recommend?
2) Any specific encryption/KMS integration docs you prefer our infra team to review before the session?

We will escalate procurement/contract questions to our legal team after the technical alignment — no blocker for the deep dive.
